## Summary
- Describe the user-facing and technical change.

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass locally or in CI.
- [ ] Migration requirements were handled (if applicable).

## Documentation Coverage (PHP/CSS/JS)
- [ ] All changed in-scope files include required documentation comments.
- [ ] Comments were updated to match final implementation behavior.
- [ ] Any exceptions are explicitly documented with rationale.

## Risk and Rollback
- [ ] Risks and mitigations are documented.
- [ ] Rollback approach is documented for production-impacting changes.
